adv_welcome.speaker: barnaby
adv_welcome.text: Welcome ashore, Cap'n! Captives do the work, pirates bring the gold. Keep the lads merry and the captives cowed, and we'll all die rich.

adv_lumber_low.speaker: barnaby
adv_lumber_low.text: Can't shiver me timbers without timber, Cap'n! We're near out of lumber.

adv_food_low.speaker: barnaby
adv_food_low.text: The captives are starving, Cap'n. More corn, more chuck tents!

adv_no_captain.speaker: barnaby
adv_no_captain.text: There's a fine ship rotting at the dock with no captain. Recruit one!

adv_idle_ship.speaker: barnaby
adv_idle_ship.text: A ship in harbour makes no gold, Cap'n. Send her out!

adv_homeless.speaker: barnaby
adv_homeless.text: Half the crew's sleeping in the dirt. Lay out some housing plots, eh?

adv_company.speaker: barnaby
adv_company.text: The lads are lonely, if you take my meaning. More wenches, Cap'n.

adv_drink.speaker: barnaby
adv_drink.text: A thirsty pirate is a dangerous pirate. We need more grog!

adv_gamble.speaker: barnaby
adv_gamble.text: The crews are bored stiff. Give 'em something to wager on.

adv_broke.speaker: barnaby
adv_broke.text: The lads haven't a coin between 'em. Send the ships out, or loosen your purse strings.

adv_unemployed.speaker: barnaby
adv_unemployed.text: There's a mob of captives loafing about the stockade. Put 'em to work!

adv_idle_skilled.speaker: barnaby
adv_idle_skilled.text: We've a skilled craftsman sitting on his hands. Build him a workshop!

adv_no_cave.speaker: barnaby
adv_no_cave.text: Don't forget yourself, Cap'n. Build a Pirate Cave and start filling your own hoard.

adv_escapes.speaker: barnaby
adv_escapes.text: Captives keep running off! We need more fear about the place.

adv_unhappy.speaker: barnaby
adv_unhappy.text: The pirates are grumbling, Cap'n. Mind their needs, or mind your neck.

adv_debt.speaker: barnaby
adv_debt.text: The treasury's bare and we're spending like admirals. No more building for now!

adv_church.speaker: barnaby
adv_church.text: The captives are asking for a church. Let the priest preach, eh?

adv_notice.speaker: barnaby
adv_notice.text: One of the Powers knows where we are and hates us. Build defences, or make peace.

ship_returns.speaker: barnaby
ship_returns.text: Our ship's back, Cap'n, and not empty-handed!

ship_returns_empty.speaker: barnaby
ship_returns_empty.text: Back already, and nothing to show for it but sunburn.

big_plunder.speaker: barnaby
big_plunder.text: Ha-HAR! Look at all that gold! Now that's a proper haul!

ship_launched.speaker: barnaby
ship_launched.text: A new ship slides down the slipway. Ain't she a beauty?

ship_sunk.speaker: barnaby
ship_sunk.text: We've lost a ship, Cap'n. Davy Jones takes his due.

mutiny.speaker: barnaby
mutiny.text: Mutiny! Starving crews don't stay loyal for long.

free_ship.speaker: barnaby
free_ship.text: Would you look at that, a ship's limped into our new dock. Finders keepers!

new_captain.speaker: barnaby
new_captain.text: A new captain's signed on. Infamous, they say. Good.

captain_returns.speaker: barnaby
captain_returns.text: Our captain's escaped his captors and come home!

escaped.speaker: barnaby
escaped.text: One got away, Cap'n. Let's hope they don't talk.

rebellion.speaker: polly
rebellion.text: Rebellion! Rebellion! Guard the palace! Squawk!

murder.speaker: barnaby
murder.text: There's been a killing. Tempers are short on this island.

starvation.speaker: barnaby
starvation.text: A captive's starved to death, Cap'n. Bad for business.

discovered.speaker: barnaby
discovered.text: They know where we are, Cap'n. That's trouble.

invasion_rumour.speaker: barnaby
invasion_rumour.text: Rumours in the taverns, Cap'n. Someone means to come for us.

invasion_fleet.speaker: barnaby
invasion_fleet.text: An invasion fleet's gathering. Man the forts!

invasion_repelled.speaker: barnaby
invasion_repelled.text: We sent 'em packing! They'll think twice before they come again!

invasion_cancelled.speaker: barnaby
invasion_cancelled.text: Looks like they've called off the attack. Phew.

enemy_sunk.speaker: barnaby
enemy_sunk.text: Down she goes! Good shooting, lads!

coup_warning1.speaker: barnaby
coup_warning1.text: The lads are muttering about mutiny, Cap'n. Mind how you go.

coup_warning2.speaker: barnaby
coup_warning2.text: They're sharpening their cutlasses, Cap'n. Fix this, quick, or it's your head!

peace.speaker: barnaby
peace.text: Peace it is, then. I'll tell the captains to behave.

peace_broken.speaker: barnaby
peace_broken.text: We broke our word, Cap'n. They won't forget it.

patron.speaker: barnaby
patron.text: We're under royal protection now. Respectable! Ugh.

patron_gift.speaker: barnaby
patron_gift.text: Our patron's sent us some coin. Generous of 'em.

jolly_roger.speaker: barnaby
jolly_roger.text: The Jolly Roger flies! We bow to no king!

war_declared.speaker: barnaby
war_declared.text: There's war in Europe, Cap'n. Good for business!

festival.speaker: barnaby
festival.text: A festival! Rum, fiddles and bonfires! The lads will love you for this!

free_grog.speaker: barnaby
free_grog.text: Free grog for all! Three cheers for the Cap'n!

ransom.speaker: barnaby
ransom.text: The ransom's paid. Pleasure doing business.

free_all.speaker: barnaby
free_all.text: Off they go, singing your praises. Soft, if you ask me.

betray.speaker: barnaby
betray.text: Hanged them, did they? Remind me never to cross you, Cap'n.

raise_dead.speaker: barnaby
raise_dead.text: The dead walk! I'll never get used to that.

assassination.speaker: barnaby
assassination.text: It's done, Cap'n. Quiet as a cat.

assassination_failed.speaker: barnaby
assassination_failed.text: Our man didn't come back, Cap'n. The target fought him off.

castaways.speaker: barnaby
castaways.text: Castaways on the beach, Cap'n! More hands for the fields.

accessory_pegleg.speaker: barnaby
accessory_pegleg.text: A fine new peg leg's been carved. Very fashionable.

accessory_hat.speaker: barnaby
accessory_hat.text: A splendid new hat is ready, Cap'n.

edict.speaker: barnaby
edict.text: It's done, Cap'n. Your word is law.

victory.speaker: barnaby
victory.text: That's it, Cap'n! Your reign's complete. They'll sing songs about you!

defeat.speaker: barnaby
defeat.text: It's all over, Cap'n. It was a good run while it lasted.
